Upper Text: You may digivolve this card from your hand onto one of your blue Tamers as if the Tamer is a level 3 blue Digimon.

[When Digivolving] By placing a blue level 3 Digimon card from your hand as the bottom digivolution card of 1 of your blue Digimon, this Digimon gains ＜Jamming＞ for the turn. (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.)
